title: Enhanced Law Enforcement at Orchard Towers
what_it_is: Enhanced Law Enforcement at Orchard Towers

sections.label: Massage establishments in Orchard Towers
sections.summary: Three licensed massage establishments currently operate in Orchard Towers, and the question asks about numbers, trends and licence limits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) what is the current number of massage establishments in Orchard Towers; (b) whether the number of licensed and unlicensed massage establishments has increased or decreased in the past three years; and (c) whether there are plans to limit the number of licences issued for massage establishments located within one mixed property development.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: There are currently three licensed massage establishments in Orchard Towers.

sections.label: Seven establishments shut down
sections.summary: In 2018 the Police detected seven such establishments, which have since been shut down.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: In 2018, the Police detected seven such establishments, which have since been shut down.

sections.label: 2018 anti-vice operations arrests
sections.summary: In 2018, 18 anti-vice operations at Orchard Towers and its vicinity led to the arrest of 76 vice workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: In 2018, 18 anti-vice operations were conducted at Orchard Towers and its vicinity, resulting in the arrest of 76 vice workers.

sections.label: Public entertainment establishments at Orchard Towers
sections.summary: Orchard Towers currently has 29 public entertainment establishments, 23 of them nightlife, with Police managing licences.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Currently, there are 29 public entertainment establishments at Orchard Towers, of which 23 are nightlife establishments and, similar to the licences for massage establishments, the Police actively manage the Public Entertainment Licences they grant, taking into consideration URA's planning intent, feedback from the community and the prevailing law and order situation.

sections.label: Police enforcement and law and order
sections.summary: The Police keep up enforcement and will watch the law and order situation at Orchard Towers and its vicinity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: In fact, the Police have been keeping up a strong tempo of enforcement actions on top of their regular checks and enhanced ground presence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: I mentioned in my earlier reply that the Police conducted 18 anti-vice operations at Orchard Towers and its vicinity in 2018 and these resulted in arrests of over 70 vice workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: The Police will continue to keep a close watch over the law and order situation at Orchard Towers, including its vicinity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Are we really tackling this vice issue or are we just going to move them to another place, which means we have an Orchard Towers Part II?

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: There has to be an outlet for people to entertain themselves.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: But what is important is the law and order situation has to be maintained and if the situation gets out of hand, the Police must ensure that whatever entertainment that we enjoy, do not cause inconvenience to others and pose law and order situations to the public.
